artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.artist: Nicolaus Beatrizet, after Marco Dente, after Baccio Bandinelli
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 31.1 × 41.3 cm (12 1/4 × 16 1/4 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a historical scene. The composition includes numerous figures engaged in dynamic action across various levels within an architectural setting. The figures are stylized with muscular physiques, involved in a struggle or dramatic narrative. They are arranged in groups, some ascending steps, with a balcony above lined with more figures. The lower part of the drawing shows figures in seated or reclining positions, displaying expressions of distress or contemplation. The use of shading and line work accentuates the physicality and emotional intensity, while a detailed pattern on the floor establishes the scene's space.

artworks.title: Trees over the River Frome at Stapleton
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features tall trees surrounded by lush greenery, with their reflections visible in calm water below. Detailed and textured brushstrokes depict the leaves and water. Various shades of green, light brown, and blue are predominant colors, suggestive of sunlight. A patch of sky can be seen in the distance, contrasting with the rich green tones. Plant life grows near the water's edge, enhancing the natural setting.

artworks.title: Trees by the River at Castle Bromwich
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The scene is of a tranquil river with trees lining the banks on both sides. The river flows gently, disappearing into the horizon. The trees, detailed with expressive pencil strokes, dominate the image. Their varying density creates depth and texture, with the grayscale palette emphasizing form and detail. The trees thin out in the distance, fading towards the edges. Stones are scattered along the riverbank.

artworks.title: Sojourner Truth
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a seated woman visible from approximately the knees up. Her body is facing slightly to the right, and she is looking directly at us. She has dark skin, defined cheekbones, deep-set eyes behind thin glasses, and her lips are set in a neutral expression. Her short hair is covered with a white cap. She is wearing a dark dress with a white fringed shawl draped over her shoulders. She is holding knitting needles and white yarn, one of her hands resting in her lap and the other on a small table on the right. The table next to her is covered with a patterned cloth and holds a vase with a bouquet of flowers, a book, and what looks like a piece of paper. The background is a plain, neutral wall. Below the photograph are two lines of text in red.

artworks.title: Design for a Stage Curtain: The Interior of an Elaborate Temple Dedicated to Illustrious Men
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and gray-brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior featuring classical elements. The scene depicts a large domed rotunda with a coffered ceiling and an ornate balcony adorned with intricate columns and statues. The walls are lined with niches housing busts and figures. In the foreground, a wide staircase with elegant balustrades leads upwards, bordered by figures engaged in various activities. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Saints Jerome and Catherine and an Angel
artworks.medium: engraving, proof before completion and letters
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with five figures in the foreground. All figures are visible from head to toe and gathered closely together. In the center, a seated woman holds a small child on her lap. The woman and child appear calm and peaceful. To the left, an older man stands with a child who holds an open book. On the right, a kneeling figure gazes towards the woman and child. Another child is seen holding a small jug on the far right. The background shows a countryside setting with mountains and architectural ruins under a large draped fabric.

artworks.title: Wagon boy or "tail boy" helping to load the wagon
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a street scene in front of a shop. The image captures a person outside a store balancing a stack of boxes. The person is dressed in vintage attire with a cap and knickerbocker-style pants. In the background, there are large doors and a window with a sign that reads "THE GLOBE THE… TUBE… MERCERIZER." The scene has a classic, early 20th-century urban feel. The texture of the building’s façade and the shadows suggest it is a sunny day. The photograph captures a candid moment of daily street life, with attention to balance and proportion in the composition.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.description: The image shows a large pottery vase and a smaller dark cube with a string draped over it. The color palette is primarily brown and grey. The vase is in the upper right and the cube is in the front, towards the bottom left, with the string extending from it onto the surface.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Nemean Lion
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in tan and black ink on buff laid paper
artworks.description: Printed with golden tan shading and black outlines on buff-colored paper, a nude, muscular man wrestles a lion in a landscape in this horizontal woodcut. The man and animal’s bodies curl around each other in the lower right quadrant of the scene. The man reaches over the back of the lion’s neck as the latter claws and the man’s leg. They battle on a path that runs across the picture from behind tall trees along the left edge of the composition and beyond rocky ground with scrubby plants along the bottom edge. A club leans against a stone in the lower right corner. Hills and trees roll back in space, reaching the top edge along the way. Closer inspection reveals the back end of a second lion going into a cave near the right edge of the woodcut. An inscription is included on a long rock along the bottom edge of the print. It reads, “RAPHAEL VR. INV.”

artworks.title: Jockeys
artworks.artist: Georges William Thornley, after Edgar Degas
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph in reddish brown on chine collé, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee

artworks.title: The Fortune Teller
artworks.artist: Jean Ganière, after Valentin de Boulogne
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight individuals gathered around a table. They are positioned closely together, some leaning over the table, engaging with each other. The individuals display a variety of facial features. The man on the far left has a long beard and curly hair partially hidden under a feathered helmet; next to him, a man with straight hair, dressed in a soldier's attire, leans in attentively. Others around the table have wavy hair and a range of expressions. The man at the center, facing away from the viewer, wears a cap with feathers and a waistcoat with elaborate patterns. The group is dressed in clothing typical of the Renaissance period, including decorative sleeves, helmets, and cloaks. They hold objects such as a glass, and one person is pouring from a jug, while another holds a bat-like object under the table. The background is a simple, cross-hatched texture without specific details. A person on the far right holds another object.

artworks.title: Stage Design of an Ancient Roman Encampment by Night (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and black wash over graphite on two joined sheets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with classical and theatrical elements. The scene depicts a grand architectural setting with a central pillar adorned with sculptures of human figures. The composition is framed by large, draped curtains that hang from the ceiling. The ceiling is supported by columns, some of which are topped with sculpted figures. There is also an indication of a cart or chariot with wheels visible to the side. The scene suggests a blend of indoor and outdoor elements, with the sky visible in the background. The artwork focuses on a meticulous rendering of architectural details and ornamentation, creating a sense of depth and perspective. The use of monochromatic shades adds a dramatic atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Cliffs Overhanging a River Gorge near Sorrento (recto)
artworks.medium: graphite and brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky gorge with sunlight infiltrating through an opening in the rock formations. The horizon is not visible, with towering vertical cliffs framing the view. Slivers of sky can be seen through the narrow gap formed by the cliffs, along with cascading vegetation. The brushwork gives a sense of texture and volume to the rocks and foliage, with highlights and shadows. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones. Uneven rock surfaces and a calm pool of water lead the gaze outward towards dense greenery and a far-off hint of a mountainous structure with architectural elements atop it.

artworks.title: Ostriches in the Desert
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three ostriches moving across an open landscape. On the horizon, there is a line of distant vegetation. The artwork features fine, linear etching techniques creating a textured surface, particularly visible in the sky and the ground. The color palette consists of shades of brown or sepia. The ostriches dominate the foreground, with the landscape stretching out beyond them towards the horizon. The overall mood conveyed is one of vastness and simplicity.

artworks.title: A Moorish Soldier before a Sunlit Wall
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing against a wall, wearing a traditional outfit with a vest, long-sleeved garment, robe, sash, footwear, and a headpiece with a plume. The person has a beard and long hair, holding a rifle in their right hand. The background is a simple, lightly shaded wall and floor with subtle watercolor textures.

artworks.title: Christ at Emmaus
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nancy Wasell Work in honor of Lessing J. Rosenwald and Alicia Craig Faxon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several figures. One figure on the left has long hair and a beard, shown in profile from the shoulders up. To the right, a group of figures is seated around a table. The figures are minimally detailed, with only the tops of their heads and general outlines visible. They are draped in loose garments. The sketch is on a plain background with minimal shading, and the lines are light and expressive.

artworks.title: A Giant Oak at the Edge of a Forest
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a large tree with a thick trunk and expansive branches. The tree's bark texture is detailed, and its leaves create a dense canopy. Other trees are faintly visible in the background. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white gradients to create contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Masqueraders Boarding Gondolas before a Venetian Palazzo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and pen and black ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper (laid on old wove card)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image displays a scene from a canal, showing a palazzo on the right. A small arched bridge crosses over the water at the end of the canal. Numerous figures are gathered on and around gondolas, with detailed and vibrant brushstrokes highlighting textures and movement in their clothing. The color palette is rich and varied, with bright attire in reds, pinks, and blues worn by the figures closer to us, contrasting against softer tones of the architecture and the sky. The water reflects these colors, adding depth. In the distance, the canal leads to a narrowing of buildings, with a tall church tower extending into the sky.

artworks.title: Christ Cleansing the Temple (after Luca Giordano)
artworks.medium: red chalk over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous figures set in an architectural environment. The composition includes figures in various poses interacting across steps under a vaulted structure. The use of red chalk gives the drawing texture and emphasizes the expressions and movements of the figures. The scene portrays activity with groups engaged in actions, potentially depicting a narrative event. The architecture in the middle ground adds depth, while the figures' postures and activities create a rhythm. An angelic figure is depicted above the main gathering, suggesting a divine or mythological context. The drawing captures a narrative moment full of emotion and movement.

artworks.title: Satan Rides and Drives the World
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a crouching figure with the full upper body and legs visible. The person is positioned in a squatting posture with both arms extended downwards, holding onto reins or ropes. The figure wears a tall, cylindrical hat that resembles a top hat, and has facial features that include a protruding nose and a prominent mustache and beard. The person's clothing details are indistinct, suggesting a bare upper body. The background is a simple textured surface, colored in a muted tan, with a signed and dated note that reads "A Hecht 1882" in the top right corner. The texture of the paper and the style of the drawing suggest it is done in charcoal and white chalk.
